title: Issues with nightly build 2021.08.01
symptom: The glycemic value is not shown on the main screen and in the system notification, even though the sensor is active and the graph shows readings. Some users also report that the blood glucose data table and calibration table could not be called up.
cause: The issue was introduced in the nightly build 2021.08.01 and was resolved in subsequent builds. The exact root cause is not explicitly stated in the thread.
fix: Users were advised to try the latest nightly build (2021.08.02) which resolved the issue for most. For those still experiencing problems, rolling back to the 2021.07.31 build was recommended. A subsequent build (2021.08.02b) fixed the related issue with BG and calibration tables.
evidence_quote: Please try the latest nightly, it is also available here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/download/2021.08.02/xDrip-plus-20210802-0af3ba0.apk If it doesn't work just roll back to the 31st July version by simply installing that over the top.
